column3: Freddie Mac FMHPI national nominal YoY growth ROLLS OVER: (Leg 1, direction) the June-2026-data or July-2026-data release prints YoY below the prior month's YoY as published in that same release — ending the post-trough acceleration run (Jan +0.9% revised trough → Apr +1.4% → May +1.9%); AND (Leg 2, level) any release covering Jun/Jul/Aug 2026 data prints YoY ≤ +1.0%. CONFIRMED requires BOTH legs by the Aug-2026-data release; otherwise MISSED (grade leg-by-leg in Outcome).
column9: FMHPI YoY ACCELERATES in both the Jun-data AND Jul-data releases (both print > +1.9%) → mechanism falsified, close MISSED early; do not wait for the Aug-data print.
column10: METRIC (exact): Freddie Mac House Price Index (FMHPI), NATIONAL, headline YoY % as published in Freddie's monthly release (freddiemac.com/research/indices/house-price-index; CalculatedRisk mirrors same-day). Release cadence ~last business day of month: Jun data ~Jul 30, Jul data ~Aug 31, Aug data ~Sep 30. REVISION RULE: grade on each release's as-published headline figures (FMHPI revises history monthly — the inherited "Mar +0.7% cycle low" was a vintage print, revised away; May-release trough = Jan 2026 +0.9%, verified via CalculatedRisk 2026-06-30 post, checked 2026-07-12). MECHANISM: Realtor.com median list price -2.4% YoY May 2026 (steepest decline since 2017, rel Jun 2026) leads close-price HPI by the 60-90d list-to-close lag → Jun-Aug close data should carry the weakness; corroborating: existing-home median +1.8% YoY Jun (NAR, rel Jul 9, decelerating), Case-Shiller real YoY negative 11 consecutive months. BASE RATE (honest): ≤+1.0% = return to the Jan trough band printed 4-5 months ago, not an extreme level call — the discriminating content is DIRECTION (rollover vs continued reaccel off the trough); naive persistence of the current +0.5pp/mo accel would say MISS, the list-price lead says HIT — that tension is the bet. IF CONFIRMED: nominal-reframe risk to HPI-linked wealth-effect reads → push to HENRY via NEXUS_BRIEF; feeds CARL's housing-consumer context. IF MISSED/FALSIFIED: the Realtor.com list-price series loses standing as a reliable 60-90d HPI lead in HOMER's toolkit — log to LESSONS.md (leading-indicator failure, not just a missed call). Year-verify discipline per LESSONS.md applied at registration (all sources 2026-stamped).
